greet.label: GREET
greet.prompt: Viewpoint from INSIDE the room looking toward the entrance: {{CUSTOMER}} stands in the open {{DOORWAY}}, framed by it, facing the viewer and waving as they step in over the threshold — the moment of arriving and greeting, seen from within the room they are entering.

leave.label: LEAVE
leave.prompt: {{CUSTOMER}} stepping OUT through the {{DOORWAY}}, facing away with an over-the-shoulder wave — the moment of leaving and saying goodbye. The outward direction (leaving, not entering) is what makes this a farewell.

ground_beef.label: GROUND_BEEF
ground_beef.prompt: {{GROUND_MEAT}} on its white butcher paper, with the {{BEEF_ICON}} printed as a single clear stamp on the paper beside the meat — marking this minced meat as beef.

meat_by_weight.label: MEAT_BY_WEIGHT
meat_by_weight.prompt: {{GROUND_MEAT}} resting on the pan of the {{SCALE}}, the dial's needle pointing to a mark on the gram face — meat being weighed, ordered by weight.

cafe.label: CAFE
cafe.prompt: An empty café interior, seen head-on: a {{COUNTER}} across the front with an {{ESPRESSO_MACHINE}} on the back wall behind it. Warm, calm, uncluttered, no people.

bakery.label: BAKERY
bakery.prompt: An empty bakery interior, seen head-on: a {{COUNTER}} across the front with {{DISPLAY_SHELVES}} on the back wall behind it. Warm, calm, uncluttered, no people.

mesnica.label: MESNICA
mesnica.prompt: An empty butcher-shop interior, seen head-on: a {{COUNTER}} across the front with a {{DISPLAY_CASE}} on the back wall behind it. Warm, calm, uncluttered, no people.
